officialReferences.title: PostgreSQL16 SET
officialReferences.support: SET LOCAL applies to the current transaction and is reverted at transaction end; rollback to an earlier savepoint also cancels it.

officialReferences.title: PostgreSQL16 JIT configuration
officialReferences.support: The jit setting controls compilation, while the cost settings determine when enabled JIT and its optimization stages are used.

officialReferences.title: PostgreSQL16 common table expression materialization
officialReferences.support: Materialization and inlining have different reuse/pushdown costs. Volatile expressions restrict folding; a flat-fixture improvement alone does not establish a public-source benefit.
